subject: Made-to-measure alcove cabinetry
hook: Alcove cupboards and shelving made to fit your walls.
gbp:
Those two alcoves either side of the chimney breast are some of the most useful storage space in a home, and the hardest to fill with off-the-shelf furniture.

SUPERIO makes alcove units to measure: cupboards below and shelves above, full-height storage, or units that house a TV, books and games. They suit Victorian and Edwardian terraces, semis and cottages where walls are uneven and every alcove is a slightly different size, as you find in many homes around Leek and across Staffordshire.

What's included:
- A free, no-obligation design consultation
- Measuring at several heights to account for uneven walls
- Your choice of finish, including matt, painted and oak-effect
- An itemised quote with no hidden costs
- Manufacture in our own workshop in Hanley
- Installation by our own team, with filler panels scribed to your walls

Tap Learn more to see our living room and alcove furniture and arrange a consultation.
